name: handhold
description: Your Handhold history and reviews in the Chat tab, from the traces the Handhold plugin records in Claude Code.
long_description: Handhold mentors you to be more ambitious when you work with Claude. This extension reads the trace files the Handhold plugin writes on your machine and gives the Chat tab a history panel and reviews. It records nothing itself, has no server and makes no network calls; Claude in your chat writes the reviews and scores.
